children: Orion Energy Systems Inc. (OESX) filed a Form 8K - Operations and Financial Condition - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 15, 2026.

On September 15, 2026, Orion Energy Systems, Inc. (the "Company") issued a press release updating its revenue outlook for fiscal 2027. A copy of the press release is furnished as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1409375/000119312526391540/oesx-20260915.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1409375/000119312526391540/0001193125-26-391540-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
